AI workspace for teams, on your own server

From design to launch, your team's whole workflow in one place.

Open rsi.am
01

Web and iPhone, on your own cloud server

The full Studio runs in any browser, with a native iPhone app in beta. Notifications reach your phone and browser. Each Space has its own always-on server with an encrypted disk.

02

Several Claude and Codex accounts, one click to switch

The Status page shows each account's usage. Auto-Run moves to an account with quota left.

03

Bugs and features in a queue, fixed, reviewed and verified

Auto-Run reproduces the issue, finds the root cause, fixes it and adds tests. A different model reviews the work. Failed checks go back for another fix.
